title: Durable execution
summary: Introduce persistent orchestration when jobs must recover or wait across long periods.

sections.label: Evaluate when needed
items: A process must survive runner/service restarts.
Approval or external data can arrive days later.
A workflow must resume without repeating external writes.
Long tasks need persistent checkpoints and inspectable progress.

sections.label: Technology option
sections.text: Temporal provides durable workflow guidance for AI applications. This is a candidate to evaluate against requirements, not a mandatory addition to the stack.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Failure recovery and resumption are tested with real side effects and recorded state. An in-memory chat history is not durable orchestration.

catalog.applicability: Use when a process must survive restarts, wait days for an approval or external data, or resume without repeating external writes. Evaluate persistent orchestration against those requirements rather than adding it to the stack by default.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
